field.label: Enabled
field.help: Disabled rules are kept but not included in the generated config.

field.label: Instance
field.help: The xray instance this rule applies to.

field.label: Name
field.help: Optional description for the rules grid.

field.label: Match
field.help: What to match on. domain — plain/keyword:/regexp:/full: patterns. ip — CIDR list. port / sourcePort — numbers and ranges like 80,443,1000-2000. network — tcp, udp or tcp,udp. inboundTag — traffic of a specific inbound (tun-in, socks-in, vless-in). geoip / geosite — lists from geoip.dat / geosite.dat (files are installed by install.sh into /usr/local/etc/xray-core/).

field.label: Value
field.help: Comma-separated values. For geoip/geosite the geoip:/geosite: prefix is added automatically if omitted.

field.label: Action
field.help: proxy — the upstream node (or balancer when enabled). balancer — the balancer only (requires Load Balancing). direct — bypass via freedom. block — blackhole.
